Title: General availability of hyper-scale event ingestion with Azure Event Hubs

Body.Content: Azure Event Hubs are a real-time highly scalable and fully managed data stream ingestion service.  As the on-ramp for stream processing in the cloud, Event Hubs enable publish subscribe data distribution in a flexible PaaS model that can scale with your needs and provide a durable buffer between event publishers and event consumers. Learn more about Event Hubs.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Event Hubs are a real-time highly scalable and fully managed data stream ingestion service. As the on-ramp for stream processing in the cloud, Event Hubs enable publish subscribe data distribution in a flexible PaaS model that can scale with your needs and provide a durable buffer between event publishers and event consumers.

Learn more about Event Hubs .
